node.title: Prefix twist-orbit constancy and moment amplification
node.statement: Let a cyclic group H of order N act multiplicatively on the evaluation domain D, and let F_z be a depth-t elementary locator-prefix fiber of A-subsets. Multiplication by zeta in H sends F_z bijectively to F_(zeta z_1,...,zeta^t z_t). If I(z)={i:z_i!=0}, the stabilizer has size s(z)=N for z=0 and gcd(N,I(z)) otherwise, so the twist orbit has N/s(z) equal-size fibers. For Q=|B|^t, R(z)=Q|F_z|/binom(N,A), and Gamma_r=Q^(r-1) sum_y (|F_y|/binom(N,A))^r, one has Gamma_r >= (N/s(z))R(z)^r/Q. For N=2^ell, s(z)=2^min_i v_2(i) on nonzero z; any prefix with a nonzero odd coordinate has a full N-element orbit. This is the first exact heavy-fiber descent rung, but supplies no moment upper bound and hence no maximum-prefix estimate by itself.
